# clerk_oauth_application (Resource)

Manages a Clerk OAuth application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_oauth_application" "my_app" {
  name         = "My OAuth App"
  callback_url = "https://example.com/oauth/callback"
  scopes       = "profile email"
  public       = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `callback_url` (String) Callback URL for the OAuth application.
- `name` (String) Name of the OAuth application.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether this is a public OAuth application. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `scopes` (String) Space-separated OAuth scopes for the application.

### Optional

- `consent_screen_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the consent screen is enabled for this OAuth application.

### Read-Only

- `authorize_url` (String) OAuth authorize URL.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret. Write-only: only returned on creation, not on subsequent reads.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the OAuth application was created.
- `discovery_url` (String) OpenID Connect discovery URL.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the OAuth application.
- `token_fetch_url` (String) OAuth token fetch URL.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the OAuth application was last updated.
- `user_info_url` (String) OAuth user info URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_oauth_application.example <oauth_application_id>
```
